title: Concept: Overly open CORS (python) — review required
description: In python, CORS_ALLOW_ALL_ORIGINSs*=s*True lets foreign origins read responses. Wildcard origins combine dangerously with credentialed requests. The remedy is an explicit origin list (CORS_ALLOWED_ORIGINS listing).
applicability: python API servers and middleware; single-line lexical scope.
risk: Cross-origin data theft where credentials apply; MEDIUM severity.
